Simulation and Hardware Results In order to test the effectiveness of the controller, the system is mod- eled using Plexim’s PLECS (Piecewise Linear Electrical Circuit Simulation) software tool within Matlab/Simulink. In all cases, the switching frequency is f = 40kHz. The simulation step size is set to t = 0.125µs so that sw sim there are 200 data points each switching cycle. For the examples discussed this paper, the parameters are summarized in Table 1. For all cases, ripple can be decreased by increasing filter sizes (primarily the AC inductor size). However, ripple reduction is not the focus of this paper. Cases1through3aresimulationresults. Case4isahardwareexperiment. For the simulations, sine-triangle modulation is used to handle switching and the AC grid ismodeled as an infinite bus. For the hardwaretest, space vector pulse with modulation (SVPWM) is used and grid voltage is emulated using an inverter.
